Each time it builds `hcast`, runs `rcases Int.natAbs_eq z`, and rewrites with `Int.cast_neg` and `Valuation.map_neg` in the negative branch. Only `z` and the closing fact differ. It is a small block, but it is real reasoning rather than unfolding: the invariance of the valuation under negation, combined with the ℕ/ℤ cast bridge. A single lemma `v(z) = v(|z|)` has no extra hypotheses, so it cannot create a dependency cycle. It can sit right after `vA_intCast_le_one`, before all three users. The `eq_of_varpi_dvd_sub` use needs `(a:ℤ) - b` as `z`, which fits the lemma. The `rw` there should be unambiguous, because the goal LHS is syntactically `A.valuation (((a:ℤ) - b : ℤ) : _)`. I did not compile it.

claims.reason: `net` and the `hqa` step of `exists_nat_lt_varpi_dvd_sub` do the same work. Both take a rational with valuation at most 1 and get a coprime denominator. Both call `exists_nat_sub_mul_den_eq` and turn `(q-a)*den = r^N*w` into `q-a = r^N*w/den`. Both then push the valuation through the quotient with the same `Rat.cast_div … map_div₀ … vA_natCast_eq_one_of_coprime … div_one` chain. Both close with `mul_le_of_le_one_right zero_le' (vA_intCast_le_one A w)`. `hqa` is the m=0, n=1 case of `net`. `hr` and `hA` are in scope there, and `hq1` gives the premise (`pow_zero` turns the bound into `≤ 1`). `net` is not used anywhere else in this file, so reusing it also gives it a client. There is no cycle: `net` is declared earlier, and it depends on neither `exists_nat_lt_varpi_dvd_sub` nor anything after it. The only cost is some `pow_zero`/`div_one`/`pow_one` normalisation at the call site. I did not compile it. The alternative factoring, a tail lemma shared by both, is also credible.
claims.shared_lemma: Reuse `net` directly: `theorem net (hr : r.Prime) (hA : A.LiesOverPrime r) (m n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) (hq : A.valuation (q : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ≤ ((A.valuation (r : AlgebraicClosure ℚ))⁻¹) ^ m) : ∃ a : ℕ, a < r ^ (n + m) ∧ A.valuation (((q - (a : ℚ) / (r : ℚ) ^ m : ℚ)) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ≤ A.valuation (r : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ^ n`. Alternatively, factor out the shared tail: `lemma vA_ratCast_sub_le (hr : r.Prime) (hA : A.LiesOverPrime r) {q : ℚ} {a N : ℕ} {w : ℤ} (hcop : q.den.Coprime r) (hw : ((q - a) * q.den : ℚ) = (r : ℚ)^N * w) : A.valuation ((q - a : ℚ) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ≤ A.valuation (r : AlgebraicClosure ℚ)^N`.
